user.title: Connect your LINAK desk
user.description: Enable Bluetooth pairing on the desk panel and close the phone app. Select your desk to check its connection and readings.

retry.title: Try connecting again
retry.description: Keep the desk within Bluetooth range, enable pairing on the panel and close other connected desk apps. Submit to try again.

finish.title: 2. Set the travel range
finish.description: Enter the lowest and highest desktop heights measured from the floor. If needed, use the physical panel to check both ends, then leave the desk still. These bounds limit commands from HA. Keep the measurement precision; do not round bounds outward.

data_description.minimum_height: Floor to the top of the desktop at its lowest position.
data_description.maximum_height: Floor to the top of the desktop at its highest position.

calibration_confirm.title: Confirm height correction
calibration_confirm.description:
**{desk_name}**

- Height: {old_height} cm → {measured_height} cm
- Travel range: {minimum_height}–{maximum_height} cm

The correction will be saved to the panel and verified. Displayed saved heights will also change; their mechanism positions stay the same. If needed, the panel connection will be prepared for HA. This step may be stored in the panel memory. Keep the desk still; confirmation will not move it.

name.title: 1. Name and connect your desk
name.description: Choose the name shown in Home Assistant. Continuing prepares the panel for HA control and may save a connection setting in its memory. The desk will not move. No phone app is needed. To only watch the desk, turn on monitoring only: nothing is written to the panel and no height range is asked for.

data_description.name: For example: Office desk.
data_description.monitoring_only: Read height and status without preparing the panel or setting a height range. Add controls later in Configure.

height.title: 3. Check the current height
height.description: Current reading: {height} cm. Check the distance from the floor to the top of the desktop. If it is correct, finish adding the desk. Otherwise, enter the current measurement in the next step. From now on, keep the desk still.

measure.title: 3. Enter the current measurement
measure.description: Keep the desk still. Measure from the floor to the top of the desktop and enter the result in centimeters. Enter the actual measurement directly. You will review and confirm the correction before it is saved.

data_description.measured_height: You can enter an exact measurement, such as 75.5 cm.

error.cannot_connect: Unable to read the desk. Check pairing, range and other connected apps.
error.timeout: The desk did not respond in time. Check pairing, Bluetooth range and connected phone apps, then try again.
error.unsupported_device: The desk returned an unsupported data format. This alpha requires the DPG1C extended readings.
error.unknown: An unexpected setup error occurred. Check the Home Assistant log for ha_linak.
error.pairing_timeout: Bluetooth pairing did not finish in time. Enable pairing on the panel and try again.
error.authentication_failed: Bluetooth authentication failed. Enable pairing on the panel and close connected desk apps, then try again.
error.pairing_unsupported: The selected Bluetooth adapter or proxy does not support explicit pairing. Use a compatible adapter or updated proxy.
error.connection_lost: The Bluetooth connection was lost while checking the desk. Enable pairing on the panel and try again.
error.pairing_agent_unavailable: Home Assistant could not prepare local Bluetooth pairing. Check the host Bluetooth service and D-Bus permissions, then try again.
error.invalid_limits: Enter valid height bounds containing the current reading. Check the desk height and try again.
error.invalid_measurement: Check the current height measurement. The desk must be stationary with a valid panel reading.
error.calibration_failed: The correction could not be verified. The setting may have changed. Check the panel reading before trying again; the write will not be retried automatically.
error.calibration_snapshot_changed: The position or height reference changed since the measurement. No correction was sent. Keep the desk still, check the current measurement and try again.
error.invalid_name: Enter a readable name between 1 and 80 characters.
error.connection_unavailable: The desk connection is unavailable. Retry after it reconnects.
error.client_preparation_failed: The panel could not be prepared. Check Bluetooth connectivity and continue to check again. No movement command was sent.
error.setting_rejected: The panel did not accept the setting. Check the current height before trying again. The integration log contains the response status.
error.idasen_conflict: This desk is also configured in an enabled IKEA Idasen Desk entry. In Settings > Devices & services, disable that IKEA entry, then retry LINAK. Keep only one integration enabled for this desk.
error.unsupported_family: This device reports a family that LINAK does not support yet. The current profile is for DPG desk panels. No DPG commands were sent. Report the model from its product label to help add support.

abort.no_devices_found: No compatible desks found. Enable pairing and check your Bluetooth adapter or active proxy.
abort.not_connectable: The device was discovered, but an active Bluetooth connection is not available. Check your local adapter or active proxy.
abort.idasen_conflict: This desk is also configured in an enabled IKEA Idasen Desk entry. In Settings > Devices & services, disable that IKEA entry, then retry LINAK. Keep only one integration enabled for this desk.

progress.connect: Connecting to your desk, authenticating Bluetooth and reading its data. The attempt takes up to 60 seconds; releasing a failed connection may take another 10 seconds. You can cancel setup.
progress.calibrate: Checking the connection and panel client. If you confirmed a height correction, it will be saved and verified. Keep the desk still. Cancellation cannot undo a write already delivered to the panel.

init.title: Desk settings
init.description: Choose what to change. Height correction and travel range have separate guided steps.

calibration_confirm.title: Confirm height correction
calibration_confirm.description:
**{desk_name}**

- Height: {old_height} cm → {measured_height} cm

The correction will be saved to the panel and verified. Displayed saved heights will also change; their mechanism positions stay the same. If needed, the panel connection will be prepared for HA. This step may be stored in the panel memory. Keep the desk still; confirmation will not move it.

name.title: Name in Home Assistant
name.description: Choose the name shown in Home Assistant. Keep the discovered name or enter your own.

height.title: Check the height
height.description: Current reading: {height} cm. Check the distance from the floor to the top of the desktop. If the reading is correct, continue. Otherwise, enter your tape measurement in the next step.

measure.title: Enter your tape measurement
measure.description: Keep the desk still. Measure from the floor to the top of the desktop and enter the result in centimeters. Enter the actual measurement directly. You will review and confirm the correction before it is saved.

data_description.measured_height: You can enter an exact measurement, such as 75.5 cm.

range.title: Travel range
range.description: Enter the lowest and highest desktop heights measured from the floor. If needed, use the physical panel to check both ends, then leave the desk still. These bounds limit commands from HA. Keep the measurement precision; do not round bounds outward.

data_description.minimum_height: Floor to the top of the desktop at its lowest position.
data_description.maximum_height: Floor to the top of the desktop at its highest position.

connect.title: Prepare desk control
connect.description: Continuing prepares the panel for HA control. If needed, a connection setting will be saved in the panel memory. Height and position will not change.

error.invalid_limits: Enter valid height bounds containing the current reading. Check the desk height and try again.
error.invalid_measurement: Check the current height measurement. The desk must be stationary with a valid panel reading.
error.calibration_failed: The correction could not be verified. The setting may have changed. Check the panel reading before trying again; the write will not be retried automatically.
error.connection_unavailable: The desk connection is unavailable. Retry after it reconnects.
error.calibration_snapshot_changed: The position or height reference changed since the measurement. No correction was sent. Keep the desk still, check the current measurement and try again.
error.invalid_name: Enter a readable name between 1 and 80 characters.
error.desk_not_stationary: Wait until the desk stops and a current height reading is available, then try again.
error.range_required: Save the lowest and highest desktop heights first. Then choose the height check in Configure.
error.setting_rejected: The panel did not accept the setting. Check the current height before trying again. The integration log contains the response status.
error.idasen_conflict: This desk is also configured in an enabled IKEA Idasen Desk entry. In Settings > Devices & services, disable that IKEA entry, then retry LINAK. Keep only one integration enabled for this desk.

progress.calibrate: Checking position, writing the correction and verifying readback. Keep the desk still. You can cancel; cancellation does not undo an already delivered write.

read_protocol_inventory.name: Read protocol inventory
read_protocol_inventory.description: Explicit administrator-only research read on the existing desk connection. Keep the desk still. Returns private raw data, not verified firmware, fault or extra-axis information. Never activates the client or changes panel settings.

config_entry_id.name: LINAK entry
config_entry_id.description: The already connected LINAK entry. This action never connects or changes the Bluetooth backend.

section.name: Read section
section.description: reference_outputs reads ten fixed output/mask characteristics. product_info sends a capabilities barrier and one product-information query. No arbitrary commands are accepted.

research_not_ready.message: Protocol research requires an enabled, already connected LINAK entry. Wait for normal readings; this action will not connect or activate the panel.

research_failed.message: The protocol research read failed. The ambiguous session was discarded; Home Assistant may reconnect through normal polling. Do not retry repeatedly or interpret missing data as a supported feature.

control_unavailable.message: The desk has no ready connection. Check Bluetooth connectivity.

movement_failed.message: Movement did not complete. Check physical stopping, bounds, stored position, availability and the ha_linak log. Commands are not queued or resumed.

stop_failed.message: Stop could not be delivered or the previous operation could not settle. Check the desk immediately and use the physical panel.

memory_unavailable.message: This stored position is empty or unavailable.

range_not_configured.message: Set the desk height range in LINAK configuration.

startup_timeout.message: The initial desk connection or read timed out. Home Assistant will retry automatically.

control_busy.message: The desk is completing another operation. Wait for it to finish or press Stop before choosing a new target. This request was not queued.

startup_waiting.message: The desk will connect after Home Assistant finishes starting.

idasen_conflict.message: This desk is also configured in an enabled IKEA Idasen Desk entry. In Settings > Devices & services, disable that IKEA entry, then retry LINAK. Keep only one integration enabled for this desk.

connection_released.message: The connection was released on purpose. Turn on Keep connected to reconnect.

connection_failed.message: The desk did not connect. Keep connected stays on and Home Assistant will retry. Check that the desk is awake and within range of your Bluetooth adapter or proxy.

reminder_client_inactive.message: The panel client is inactive. Panel preference and reminder changes require status 1; this action does not activate the client. Use the explicit control preparation in Configure, then read the current settings before trying again.

reminder_failed.message: The panel setting change could not be verified. The setting may have changed. Check the stored unit preference, profile and durations after reconnecting before trying again. The stored preference does not confirm the unit currently rendered on the display. No write or restoration is retried automatically.

reminder_interval_invalid.message: Enter a whole number of minutes from 1 to 60. These are integration edit limits, not firmware or medical limits. Existing panel values outside this range are preserved. Use Off to disable reminders.

reminder_profile_active.message: Profile 1 is active. Only inactive-profile interval editing has been observed on hardware. Select Off or another profile explicitly before changing its sitting time. No duration was written.
